dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 50 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.2:1 (maximum pixel base width to maximum vertical pixel height).

other_distinctive_markers: Subject is a low-poly digital mesh with a uniform cyan emissive texture and faceted geometry.
